description: A nonempty expanded structure models the actual encoded theory exactly when it satisfies the five equality requirements and every actual translated sentence from \(T\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.encodedTheory_models_iff.{u, v, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {N : Type z}
  [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Extended L).Structure N] [Nonempty N] (T : L.Theory) :
  N ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.encodedTheory T ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Axioms L N ∧
      ∀ A ∈ T, N ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.translate A
